name: The Church App
intro:
⚠️ BEFORE STEP 1 — this app is tested on your REAL copy, not a test copy. Your own information will already be there and there is no “🧪 Test copy” mark. Where a step expects an empty app or a welcome card, write down what you actually saw instead of reporting it as a fault.

This is Immanuel Church's real, live app, so please don't send anything to the church. You will write two sermon notes, find them again, try the prayer page without sending, and switch the app to dark.

steps.do: Near the bottom of the Home screen, find the tip that starts “Add to Home Screen” and tap “GOT IT”.
steps.see: The tip goes away. The Home screen shows the latest message at the top and upcoming events under it.
steps.tip: If you don't see the tip, you hid it before — just go on to the next step.

steps.do: Scroll down to “Discussion guide” and tap “📝 My notes on this message”.
steps.see: A “📝 Sermon Notes” panel opens with two tabs, “🎙 During” and “✨ After”. Lower down, under “✍️ My notes”, it says “No notes yet.”

steps.do: Tap the box under “✍️ My notes” (it says “What stood out…”) and type this note.
steps.see: Your words are in the box.

steps.do: Tap “Add” next to the box.
steps.see: Your note “Grandma’s favorite verse is Acts 2:4” appears under the box with a • in front, the apostrophe looks right, “No notes yet.” is gone and the box is empty again.

steps.do: With the box empty, tap “Add” again.
steps.see: Nothing is added — there is still just your one note.

steps.do: At the top of the panel, tap “✨ After”.
steps.see: Under “📜 Scriptures in this sermon” you see “📖 Acts 2:4” (picked up from your note). Under “💬 Questions to take home” the last question is “Read Acts 2:4. What does it say to you today?”

steps.do: Scroll down to “📤 Share” and tap “Share this sermon”.
steps.see: Your iPhone's share menu opens with the sermon title, questions and verses ready to send. Tap ✕ or Cancel to close it — don't send it.

steps.do: Tap the ✕ at the top-right of the Sermon Notes panel.
steps.see: The panel closes and you are back on the Home screen.

steps.do: Tap “Watch” in the bar at the bottom.
steps.see: The “Messages” list opens, newest message at the top, with buttons for each series (“All” and the series names) above it.

steps.do: Tap the message at the top of the list.
steps.see: The message opens with a “Watch message” button, and under “My notes” the box already holds “Grandma’s favorite verse is Acts 2:4”.

steps.do: Tap “Back” at the top-left.
steps.see: You are back on the Messages list, and now the top message has a “Notes saved” label.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: The app comes back on the Messages list and the top message still says “Notes saved”.

steps.do: Tap “Prayer” in the bar at the bottom.
steps.see: “Let's pray together” is at the top, and the box under it says “Your prayer list is empty.”

steps.do: Scroll down to “Share a request”. Leave both boxes empty and tap “Send to the prayer team”.
steps.see: Nothing is sent. A short note at the bottom says “Add a request first” and the “How can we pray for you?” box is ready for typing.
steps.tip: Please don't type a real request and send it here — sending opens an email to the church office.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then tap “Home” in the bar at the bottom.
steps.see: The Home screen still shows the latest message and the upcoming events.

steps.do: Tap “📝 My notes on this message” again.
steps.see: The Sermon Notes panel opens and your note “Grandma’s favorite verse is Acts 2:4” is still there.

steps.do: Type this second note in the box, then tap “Add”.
steps.see: “Pray for Pastor Dan’s trip” is added under your first note, even with no signal.

steps.do: Tap the ✕ at the top-right to close the panel, then turn Airplane Mode off.
steps.see: You are back on the Home screen.

steps.do: Tap “More” at the bottom, scroll down to “Appearance” and choose “Dark” from the menu.
steps.see: The whole screen turns dark right away.

steps.do: Tap “Home” at the bottom.
steps.see: The Home screen is dark too. That's the end — thank you! (To go back to normal: More → Appearance → “System”.)

steps.do: Now the videos. This app has 3. Open each one and watch it right through, sound on: Explain it to me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=church&mode=firsttime  Watch it work — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=church  Train me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=church&mode=train
steps.see: Each one talks without stopping — no long silences, no sentence starting again. The screen behind the words changes to match what is being said, and when it points at something, that thing is really there. If a video talks about a button or a screen you did not see in this app, say so — that is a real fault and one of the most useful things you can find.

steps.do: Last, the shop page everyone sees before they buy: https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/ — find this app on its shelf and read its card.
steps.see: The name, the one-line description and the price all match the app you just used. Nothing on the card promises something the app does not do. If the card and the app disagree, the card is the fault — say which bit.
